pokedexEntries.sc: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

pokedexEntries.vi: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

pokedexEntries.za: Glimmora blooms into a large flower made of poisonous components. It works together with groups of Glimmet to repel enemies.
